API ReferenceZIdentity APIUsersUsers Ops Get User Groups
Users Ops Get User Groups
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/users/:id/groups

Retrieves a paginated list of groups associated with a specific user ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

The user ID of the individual whose groups details are to be retrieved.

QUERY PARAMETERS
offset
int32

Possible values: >= 0

The starting point for pagination, with the number of records that can be skipped before fetching results.

limit
int32

Possible values: >= 0 and <= 1000

The maximum number of records to return per request. Minimum: 0, Maximum: 1000

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and returns a paginated list of groups for the specified user.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
results_total
int64
REQUIRED

The total number of records available.

pageOffset
int64
REQUIRED

The starting point of the current page in pagination. Helps determine which set of records is being displayed.

pageSize
int64
REQUIRED

The number of records included in a single response page.

next_link
string
REQUIRED

URL link to the next page of the records, if available. Helps to navigate through paginated results.

prev_link
string
REQUIRED

URL link to the previous page of the records, if available.

records
object[]
REQUIRED
]
